subtitles.title.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Page title and the Settings root row for the subtitle look.

subtitles.detail.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Detail line under the Subtitles row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

subtitles.about_blend.value: Soft, slightly translucent text with a diffuse shadow. It eases toward the scene's brightness and stays below HDR peak.
subtitles.about_blend.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Blend with video preset is the look. Two short sentences.

subtitles.about_apple_tv.value: White text with a soft shadow, modelled on Apple TV's default look.
subtitles.about_apple_tv.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Apple TV preset is the look. Apple TV is a brand name.

subtitles.about_classic.value: White text on a black box, square corners: the look of broadcast closed captions.
subtitles.about_classic.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Classic preset is the look.

subtitles.about_netflix.value: White text with a hard drop shadow and no box.
subtitles.about_netflix.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Netflix preset is the look. Netflix is a brand name.

subtitles.about_outline.value: White text with a thick black outline, no box. The most readable choice over bright or busy pictures.
subtitles.about_outline.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Outline preset is the look.

subtitles.about_large_print.value: Bigger, bolder text with an outline, for reading from far away.
subtitles.about_large_print.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Large print preset is the look.

subtitles.about_high_contrast.value: Yellow text with a black outline on a dark box, for the most contrast.
subtitles.about_high_contrast.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the High contrast preset is the look.

subtitles.about_marquee.value: Inter Bold, white, with a thin outline: Marquee's own look.
subtitles.about_marquee.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the Marquee preset is the look. Inter is a typeface name; Marquee is the app name.

subtitles.about_custom.value: Your own mix of settings. Pick a preset to start over.
subtitles.about_custom.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Narrative line under the page title when the look matches no preset.

subtitles.group_look.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. The preset and the sample shown.

subtitles.group_text.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. Font, size, colour, opacity, weight.

subtitles.group_edge.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. Outline or shadow around the letters.

subtitles.group_background.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. The box behind the words.

subtitles.group_position.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. Where the caption sits and how its lines are spaced.

subtitles.group_behavior.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Section heading on the Settings > Subtitles page. How captions behave: Blend with video, Reveal as spoken, authored styling, reset.

subtitles.row_preset.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. The whole look in one pick.

subtitles.row_sample.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Which sample text the preview shows.

subtitles.row_scene.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Which picture the preview sits over.

subtitles.row_font.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. The typeface.

subtitles.row_size.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Letter size in percent.

subtitles.row_color.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Colour of the letters, or of the box (under Background).

subtitles.row_opacity.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. How opaque the letters or the box are, in percent.

subtitles.row_bold.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Heavier weight on or off. The value is On or Off.

subtitles.row_edge.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Outline or shadow style.

subtitles.row_edge_width.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Outline or shadow strength in pixels.

subtitles.row_back.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Box behind the words: none, line or window.

subtitles.row_radius.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Corner radius of the box.

subtitles.row_padding.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Air between the words and the box edge.

subtitles.row_anchor.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Whether the caption hangs from the bottom or the top of the screen.

subtitles.row_nudge.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. How far the caption sits from the screen edge, in pixels.

subtitles.row_line_spacing.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Space between the lines of a caption, in percent.

subtitles.row_blend.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Switch: the caption's brightness follows the scene. Same name as the player's Style page.

subtitles.row_reveal.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Show each word or line as it is spoken. Same name as the player's Style page.

subtitles.row_styled.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. What happens to subtitle files that bring their own styling.

subtitles.row_reset.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Row label on the Settings > Subtitles page. A short label; its value is on the right. Action: return to the preset the look is named after.

subtitles.blend_detail.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Line under the Blend with video row.

subtitles.reset_detail.value: Back to the preset's own settings
subtitles.reset_detail.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Line under the Reset to preset row.

subtitles.value_auto.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. Size or colour follows the player's own Size or Color pick.

subtitles.value_square.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. Rounded corners at zero.

subtitles.color_white.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour.

subtitles.color_soft_white.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour: slightly dimmed white.

subtitles.color_yellow.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour.

subtitles.color_cyan.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour.

subtitles.color_green.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour.

subtitles.color_pink.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A text colour.

subtitles.color_black.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A box colour.

subtitles.color_plum.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A box colour: dark purple.

subtitles.color_slate.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A box colour: dark blue-grey.

subtitles.color_brown.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A box colour.

subtitles.anchor_bottom.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. The caption hangs from the bottom of the screen.

subtitles.anchor_top.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. The caption hangs from the top of the screen.

subtitles.styled_keep.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A subtitle file's own fonts, colours and sizes are drawn as its author set them.

subtitles.styled_mine.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Value shown on the right of a row on the Settings > Subtitles page. A subtitle file's own fonts, colours and sizes are replaced by the viewer's look.

subtitles.sample_accents.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name on the Settings > Subtitles page: what the sample caption shows. Latin accents.

subtitles.sample_cjk.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text. CJK is the usual abbreviation; keep it if the language uses it.

subtitles.sample_rtl.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name on the Settings > Subtitles page: what the sample caption shows. Right-to-left scripts.

subtitles.sample_symbols.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name on the Settings > Subtitles page: what the sample caption shows. Musical notes, symbols and emoji.

subtitles.sample_italics.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name on the Settings > Subtitles page: what the sample caption shows. Italic, bold and plain text in one caption.

subtitles.sample_styled.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample text name on the Settings > Subtitles page: what the sample caption shows. A subtitle file that carries its own fonts and colours (used to show the Styled subtitles row).

subtitles.scene_day.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample scene name on the Settings > Subtitles page: the picture behind the preview. A bright daytime picture.

subtitles.scene_night.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample scene name on the Settings > Subtitles page: the picture behind the preview. A dark picture.

subtitles.scene_snow.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Sample scene name on the Settings > Subtitles page: the picture behind the preview. A very bright, nearly white picture.

subtitles.sample_tag.description: Settings > Subtitles page. Label in the corner of the preview picture. {number} is the sample's place, {total} how many there are, {name} the sample's name.
